description: Historical heads of state (and appointed colonial governors) 1836-1900 for Historical Mode succession. Rules applied by the engine: (1) 'died' dates are treated as exogenous biology in Historical Mode — the person dies on that date if still alive in the simulation; (2) end reasons 'abdicated', 'deposed', 'revolution' are NOT forced — they happen only if the simulation produces them; (3) a listed successor is used only if the country's governance matches the record's 'governance' and (for records flagged after_regime_change) the simulated country has itself undergone a regime change within ±4 years; otherwise a successor is generated. Sandbox Mode ignores this file except for the starting ruler and the heir recorded in the 1836 profile. Records citing wikipedia_en (added 2026-11-15) replace randomly generated successors for countries that had no researched succession; regnal and term dates read from the cited article on the access date.
